recognize_zh: 抹片同時出現數個有核紅血球、髓細胞與顆粒球左移，另見大小不一的紅血球與少量變形紅血球，呈類似骨髓增生性腫瘤的白血球–紅血球母細胞樣（leukoerythroblastic）變化；需配合鐮狀細胞疾病與小病毒 B19 感染的臨床背景判讀。
features: Several nucleated red blood cells with dense pyknotic nuclei and orthochromatic to polychromatic cytoplasm
Immature granulocytes including a myelocyte and a promyelocyte-like cell with coarse granules, together with segmented neutrophils (left shift)
Large cell with vacuolated granular cytoplasm and immature nucleus (lower center), likely a reactive/immature myeloid cell
Red cells with anisopoikilocytosis, including occasional polychromatophilic cells, target-like forms and a rare elongated cell; few classic sickle cells in this field
Platelets not increased in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukoerythroblastic picture with multiple circulating nucleated red cells, immature granulocytes at myelocyte and earlier stages, and mature neutrophils. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with scattered polychromatophilic and target-like forms, although classic sickle cells are few in this field. No definite blasts with Auer rods are identified. In a toddler with sickle cell disease, this pattern can mimic a myeloproliferative neoplasm; parvovirus B19 testing (PCR, bone marrow for giant pronormoblasts) is recommended. Findings are suggestive of a reactive leukoerythroblastic reaction related to parvovirus B19 infection.

ddx.vs: JMML shows persistent monocytosis, splenomegaly, elevated HbF and RAS-pathway mutations, whereas the parvovirus reaction is transient and lacks clonal genetics.
Clonal MPN/TAM shows blasts, megakaryocytic atypia and a genetic driver (e.g., GATA1, JAK2), whereas parvovirus-associated changes resolve with viral clearance.
Infiltration shows teardrop cells and marrow fibrosis or tumor on biopsy, while parvovirus marrow shows giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions.

ddx.dx: Hyposplenism in sickle cell disease alone
ddx.vs: Sickle hyposplenism causes Howell-Jolly bodies, target cells and few nRBCs but not a marked left shift with immature granulocytes.
